static.purpose: Paint the whole surface one uniform color as a visible base.

gradient.purpose: Blend two or more colors across the keyboard as a static spatial ramp.

breath.purpose: Fade brightness smoothly up and down like breathing.

blink.purpose: Turn the surface on and off in a regular blink; keep the period at or above 340 ms.

rainbow_wave.purpose: Scroll a rainbow palette along a row or column.

wave.purpose: Send a single-color brightness wave across the surface.

scroll.purpose: Move a bright band along an axis like a marquee or scanner.

sparkle.purpose: Light random points that fade out like stars or glitter; colors come from the palette.

drift.purpose: Float small clusters slowly across the surface with optional wobble.

ring.purpose: Spawn colorful rings that expand or contract and fade out.

key_ring.purpose: Expand a ring from each pressed key, up to a limited number of waves. Audio onset may set params.origin=random_key for scattered rings, or board_center for one central event.

mote.purpose: Drift many tiny soft points across the surface like fireflies or dust.

reactive.purpose: Light each pressed key and fade it out.

ripple.purpose: Send a ring out from each pressed key, horizontally or as a square.

ripple_square.purpose: Send a square ring out from each pressed key.

aurora.purpose: Spread soft color bands sideways from pressed keys.

spectrum.purpose: Show audio frequency bars across the keyboard columns.

spectrum_mirror.purpose: Show audio bars mirrored out from the center.

spectrum_sum.purpose: Drive one width of audio level across the whole keyboard.

key_tint.purpose: Tint keys while they are held down.

spiral.purpose: Rotate colored arms around the center of the keyboard.

block_stack.purpose: Animate falling blocks that stack, clear lines and reset.

key_burst.purpose: Burst outward from each pressed key with a brief flash, trail and afterglow. Audio onset may set params.origin=random_key for a deterministic random key.

rain.purpose: Fall ambient rain with a built-in night background and bottom splashes.

fire.purpose: Grow flickering flames from one edge of the surface toward the opposite edge.
